sentences.en: What with joy and shame, she blushed to the ears.
sentences.zh: 她又羞又喜，脸红到了耳朵。

sentences.en: Shame on you for getting so flustered. You looked ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 你这么紧张真是丢人。你看起来很可笑。

sentences.en: I cannot sing in front of an audience for shame.
sentences.zh: 我因为害羞而不敢在观众面前唱歌。

phrases.zh: 真可惜（表示遗憾或失望）

senses.zh: 羞耻，羞愧；憾事，带来耻辱的人
